title: 積分球輻射量測~Integrating-sphere radiometry
focus: 球倍增因子、塗層與開口、替代法校正與總光通量不確定度~Sphere multiplier, coating and ports, substitution calibration and total-flux uncertainty
summary: 從朗伯漫反射壁面如何把任意方向的光通量變成均勻輻射亮度出發，推導球倍增因子 M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f))，再逐步建立塗層、開口、擋板、偵測器、標準燈替代法與自吸收修正，最後以不確定度預算與國家實驗室比對完成總光通量量測系統的驗收。~Starting from how a Lambertian diffuse wall turns flux from any direction into uniform radiance, this course derives the sphere multiplier M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f)), then builds up coating, ports, baffles, detector, standard-lamp substitution and self-absorption correction, and closes with an uncertainty budget and a national-laboratory comparison to accept a total-luminous-flux measurement system.

units.anchor: 朗伯漫反射壁面與球倍增因子~Lambertian wall and the sphere multiplier
units.title: 積分球的輻射交換原理~Radiative exchange inside the integrating sphere
units.mechanism: 積分球的內壁是高反射率的朗伯漫反射面：任一點被照亮後向所有方向以餘弦分佈再輻射，而球面幾何的特性是球內任意一點發出的光在其他所有壁面上造成相同的輻照度，與方向無關。於是輸入光通量 Φ 經過無窮多次反射後，壁面輻照度成為等比級數的和，比值由壁面反射率 ρ 與開口比 f（所有開口面積佔球面積的比例）決定。偵測器看到的是這個經過空間積分、與光源方向和分佈無關的均勻輻射亮度，這就是「積分」的意義。~The inner wall of an integrating sphere is a highly reflective Lambertian diffuser: any illuminated point re-radiates in all directions with a cosine distribution, and the geometry of a sphere makes light leaving any point produce the same irradiance on every other part of the wall regardless of direction. The input flux Φ therefore builds up through an infinite series of reflections, and the wall irradiance becomes a geometric sum whose ratio depends on wall reflectance ρ and port fraction f (the fraction of sphere area occupied by all openings). The detector sees this spatially integrated radiance, independent of the source's direction and distribution, which is what integrating means.
units.model: 球倍增因子 M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f))。取 ρ = 0.98、f = 0.03：M = 0.98/(1 − 0.98×0.97) = 0.98/0.0494 = 19.8；ρ = 0.95 時 M = 0.95/(1 − 0.9215) = 12.1；ρ 只從 0.98 掉到 0.97，M = 0.97/(1 − 0.9409) = 16.4，下降 17%。壁面反射率 1% 的變化放大成約 17% 的通量變化，這是積分球量測必須用替代法的根本原因。~The sphere multiplier is M = ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f)). With ρ = 0.98 and f = 0.03, M = 0.98/(1 − 0.98×0.97) = 0.98/0.0494 = 19.8; with ρ = 0.95, M = 0.95/(1 − 0.9215) = 12.1; if ρ merely drops from 0.98 to 0.97, M = 0.97/(1 − 0.9409) = 16.4, a 17% fall. A 1% change in wall reflectance becomes roughly a 17% change in throughput, the root reason sphere measurements must use substitution.
units.verify: 用穩定的 LED 或雷射把已知光通量（先以功率計量得）打入球內，記錄偵測器訊號，再把同一光源的入射方向從正對壁面改成斜射 30°、45°，確認訊號變化小於 0.5%，證明方向無關性；最後以輸入功率、偵測器面積與響應度反推 M，與 ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f)) 的估計值比較。~Inject a known flux (first measured with a power meter) from a stable LED or laser into the sphere, record the detector signal, then change the entry direction from normal to 30° and 45° off the wall and confirm that the signal changes by less than 0.5%, demonstrating direction independence; finally back out M from input power, detector area and responsivity and compare with the ρ/(1 − ρ(1 − f)) estimate.
units.failure: 把球壁當成普通白漆面、容許 10% 的開口比，倍增因子降到個位數且首次反射光直接進入偵測器，量測值隨光源擺放角度變動 5% 以上，積分球失去積分功能。~Treating the wall as ordinary white paint and allowing a 10% port fraction drops the multiplier to single digits and lets first-bounce light reach the detector directly; readings then vary by more than 5% with source orientation and the sphere no longer integrates.
units.misconception: 積分球只要內壁是白色的就能把光均勻混合，反射率差幾個百分點無關緊要。~Any white interior mixes light uniformly, so a few percent of wall reflectance makes no difference.

units.anchor: 壁面輻照度與偵測器通量~Wall irradiance and detector flux
units.title: 輻射量鏈：通量、輻照度、輻射亮度到光電流~The radiometric chain from flux and irradiance to photocurrent
units.mechanism: 穩態下壁面輻照度 E = Φ·M/A_s，其中 A_s = 4πR² 是球內表面積；朗伯面的輻射亮度 L = E/π（單位 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹）。與壁面齊平的偵測器開口接收的通量就是 E 乘以它的面積，因此偵測器訊號正比於輸入總通量，比例常數包含 M、A_s、偵測器面積與響應度。量測總光通量時光源放在球心（4π 配置），量測定向光源時光源在開口外照入（2π 配置），量測反射率或穿透率時樣品裝在樣品埠；三種配置的 M 與 f 都不同，校正必須在同一配置下進行。~In steady state the wall irradiance is E = Φ·M/A_s with A_s = 4πR² the interior area, and for a Lambertian wall the radiance is L = E/π (in W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹). A detector aperture flush with the wall collects E times its area, so the detector signal is proportional to the total input flux with a constant that contains M, A_s, detector area and responsivity. For total flux the source sits at the sphere centre (4π configuration), a directional source shines in through a port (2π configuration), and reflectance or transmittance samples mount on a sample port; each configuration has its own M and f, so calibration must be done in the same configuration as the measurement.
units.model: 直徑 200 mm 的球：A_s = 4π×0.1² = 0.1257 m²。輸入 1 W、M = 19.8 時 E = 19.8/0.1257 = 157.9 W/m²，L = E/π = 50.3 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹。面積 1 mm² 的矽光二極體收到 157.9×10⁻⁶ = 0.158 mW；在 555 nm 取響應度 0.33 A/W，光電流 52 µA。整球對該偵測器的「效率」只有 0.016%，所以積分球是用通量換均勻性的元件。~For a 200 mm diameter sphere A_s = 4π×0.1² = 0.1257 m². With 1 W input and M = 19.8, E = 19.8/0.1257 = 157.9 W/m² and L = E/π = 50.3 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹. A 1 mm² silicon photodiode receives 157.9×10⁻⁶ = 0.158 mW; at a responsivity of 0.33 A/W near 555 nm the photocurrent is 52 µA. The sphere's efficiency onto that detector is only 0.016%, showing that an integrating sphere trades flux for uniformity.
units.verify: 以已校正的功率計量一支 532 nm 雷射的功率，再把它射入球內量光電流，由光電流除以響應度與偵測器面積得到 E，再乘上 A_s/M 回推輸入功率，與功率計值比較；差異應小於塗層反射率不確定度所預測的範圍（約 5–10%）。~Measure the power of a 532 nm laser with a calibrated power meter, then shine it into the sphere and record the photocurrent; divide by responsivity and detector area to obtain E, multiply by A_s/M to recover the input power and compare with the power-meter value; the difference should lie within the range predicted by the coating-reflectance uncertainty (about 5–10%).
units.failure: 把量定向光源用的 2π 配置校正係數直接套用在球心 4π 配置上，開口比與自吸收都不同，總光通量系統性偏差 3–8%，而且不同形狀的燈偏差不一樣。~Applying a calibration factor obtained in the 2π configuration for directional sources to the 4π centre-mount configuration ignores the different port fraction and self-absorption, producing a systematic 3–8% total-flux error that changes with lamp shape.
units.misconception: 偵測器收到的通量等於輸入通量除以開口數，與球的大小無關。~The detector receives the input flux divided by the number of ports, independent of sphere size.

units.anchor: 燒結 PTFE 塗層與開口比~Sintered-PTFE coating and port fraction
units.title: 塗層材料、開口設計與擋板~Coating materials, port design and baffles
units.mechanism: 可見與近紅外積分球多用燒結 PTFE（厚度約 10 mm 才能達到 0.99 的反射率，因為材料半透明）或硫酸鋇漆（約 0.97–0.98，較便宜但易受污染與紫外老化）；中紅外改用鍍金粗化表面，在 0.8–20 µm 保持 0.95–0.98。開口比 f 必須壓到幾個百分點以內，而且入口與偵測器之間要加同材質的擋板，阻止第一次反射光直接進入偵測器；擋板本身也算進有效開口比。樣品埠、燈座與導線都會吸收光，使實際的 f 比純幾何計算大。~Visible and near-infrared spheres use sintered PTFE (about 10 mm thick to reach 0.99 reflectance because the material is translucent) or barium-sulfate paint (about 0.97–0.98, cheaper but prone to contamination and ultraviolet aging); mid-infrared spheres use roughened gold surfaces holding 0.95–0.98 from 0.8 to 20 µm. The port fraction f must be kept to a few percent, and a baffle of the same material between entrance and detector blocks first-bounce light from reaching the detector; the baffle itself counts toward the effective port fraction. Sample ports, lamp holders and leads absorb light too, making the real f larger than the pure geometric value.
units.model: 200 mm 球開 25.4 mm 入口、25.4 mm 樣品埠與 12.7 mm 偵測器埠：開口面積 = 2×π×12.7² + π×6.35² = 1140 mm²，球面積 125,664 mm²，幾何開口比 f = 0.0091；加上擋板、燈座與樣品架後有效 f 取 0.03（教學假設）。塗層 ρ 從 0.98 提升到 0.99 時 M 由 19.8 升到 0.99/(1 − 0.99×0.97) = 24.9，提高 26%，因此高反射塗層與低開口比同樣重要。~A 200 mm sphere with a 25.4 mm entrance, 25.4 mm sample port and 12.7 mm detector port has a port area of 2×π×12.7² + π×6.35² = 1140 mm² against a sphere area of 125,664 mm², a geometric port fraction f = 0.0091; adding the baffle, lamp holder and sample fixture the effective f is taken as 0.03 (teaching assumption). Raising the coating ρ from 0.98 to 0.99 lifts M from 19.8 to 0.99/(1 − 0.99×0.97) = 24.9, a 26% gain, so high-reflectance coating matters as much as low port fraction.
units.verify: 用分光光度計配小型參考球量塗層試片在 250–2500 nm 的半球反射率，確認可見波段 ≥ 0.98 且 250 nm 處不低於 0.95；再以小面積光源掃描球內壁，量偵測器訊號隨入射位置的變化（空間響應分布），確認擋板已消除直接照射的尖峰。~Measure the hemispherical reflectance of a coating coupon from 250 to 2500 nm with a spectrophotometer and a small reference sphere, confirming ≥ 0.98 in the visible and no less than 0.95 at 250 nm; then scan a small source across the interior wall and record the detector signal versus entry position (the spatial response distribution) to confirm that the baffle has removed the direct-illumination spike.
units.failure: 硫酸鋇塗層被手指油脂與燈具揮發物污染後在藍光區反射率降到 0.93，藍光 LED 的量測值比紅光 LED 多掉 15%，整套色度量測出現偏黃的系統誤差。~Once barium-sulfate coating is contaminated by finger oils and lamp outgassing its blue reflectance falls to 0.93, blue LEDs read 15% lower than red ones, and the whole colorimetric measurement acquires a yellow bias.
units.misconception: 塗層越薄越好，因為薄塗層比較不會剝落，反射率和厚度無關。~Thinner coating is better because it does not flake, and reflectance has nothing to do with thickness.

units.anchor: V(λ) 光度計頭與光譜輻射計~V(λ) photometer head and spectroradiometer
units.title: 偵測器、光譜匹配與線性~Detector, spectral matching and linearity
units.mechanism: 偵測端有兩條路：光度計頭是矽光二極體加 V(λ) 濾光片組合，直接讀出光度量，但濾光片與 V(λ) 的失配（以 f1' 指標描述，好的光度計約 1.5–3%）在光源光譜與校正燈不同時產生誤差；光譜輻射計透過光纖接到球壁，量出相對光譜後以數值積分得到總光譜輻射通量與光通量，失配問題轉為波長校正與雜散光問題。兩者都要求偵測器在 4 個數量級的通量範圍內線性，並把溫度係數控制在 0.1%/K 以內。~The detection end has two routes: a photometer head combining a silicon photodiode with a V(λ) filter reads photometric quantities directly, but the mismatch between filter and V(λ) (described by the f1' index, about 1.5–3% for a good head) causes error whenever the source spectrum differs from the calibration lamp; a spectroradiometer coupled to the wall by a fibre measures the relative spectrum and numerically integrates it into total spectral radiant flux and luminous flux, converting the mismatch problem into wavelength-calibration and stray-light problems. Both require detector linearity over four decades of flux and a temperature coefficient below 0.1%/K.
units.model: 光譜失配修正因子 F* = [∫S_ref·V dλ/∫S_ref·s dλ]·[∫S_DUT·s dλ/∫S_DUT·V dλ]，其中 s(λ) 是光度計的實際相對響應。以 2856 K 鎢絲標準燈校正、量測藍光比例高的白光 LED 時，f1' = 3% 的光度計常算出 F* ≈ 1.015（教學假設）；若不套用修正，光通量系統性偏低 1.5%。光通量本身為 Φ_v = 683 lm/W × ∫Φ_e(λ)V(λ)dλ，所以 1 W 的 555 nm 單色光等於 683 lm。~The spectral mismatch correction factor is F* = [∫S_ref·V dλ/∫S_ref·s dλ]·[∫S_DUT·s dλ/∫S_DUT·V dλ], where s(λ) is the photometer's actual relative response. Calibrating with a 2856 K tungsten standard lamp and measuring a blue-rich white LED, a photometer with f1' = 3% typically yields F* ≈ 1.015 (teaching assumption); omitting the correction biases luminous flux low by 1.5%. Luminous flux itself is Φ_v = 683 lm/W × ∫Φ_e(λ)V(λ)dλ, so 1 W of monochromatic 555 nm light equals 683 lm.
units.verify: 以單色儀或一組窄帶 LED 量光度計頭的相對光譜響應 s(λ)，計算 f1'；同時用同一支白光 LED 在光度計頭與光譜輻射計兩條路徑各量一次光通量，兩者套用修正後應一致在 1% 內。線性則以疊加法（兩個光源分別與同時點亮）在 3–4 個數量級內驗證，偏差應小於 0.2%。~Measure the photometer head's relative spectral response s(λ) with a monochromator or a set of narrow-band LEDs and compute f1'; measure one white LED's luminous flux through both the photometer and the spectroradiometer path, which after correction should agree within 1%. Verify linearity by the superposition method (two sources lit separately and together) over three to four decades, with deviations below 0.2%.
units.failure: 光譜輻射計的雜散光讓深紅與近紅外區出現虛假訊號，與 V(λ) 相乘後雖小，但在藍光 LED 上卻把光通量抬高 2%，而且隨 LED 色溫系統性變化。~Stray light in the spectroradiometer produces false signal in the deep red and near infrared; although small after weighting by V(λ), it raises blue-LED luminous flux by 2% and the error shifts systematically with LED colour temperature.
units.misconception: 只要偵測器是校正過的，光源光譜不同也不需要任何修正。~A calibrated detector needs no correction even when the source spectrum differs from the calibration lamp.

units.anchor: 總光通量標準燈與輔助燈~Total-flux standard lamp and auxiliary lamp
units.title: 替代法校正與自吸收修正~Substitution calibration and self-absorption correction
units.mechanism: 因為 M 對 ρ 極敏感，絕對量測不可行，積分球永遠用替代法：先把可追溯至 NIST 等國家實驗室的總光通量標準燈放在球心讀訊號 S_ref，再換上待測燈讀 S_DUT，比值乘以標準燈的認證值就是待測光通量。但待測燈的燈體、燈座與反射罩會吸收球內的光，改變 M；於是球壁上裝一支輔助燈，分別在標準燈與待測燈在位（均不點亮）時點亮輔助燈讀訊號，兩者比值就是自吸收修正因子。標準燈的電流、預熱時間與極性必須按證書操作，否則認證值失效。~Because M is so sensitive to ρ, absolute measurement is impractical and spheres always use substitution: a total-luminous-flux standard lamp traceable to a national laboratory such as NIST is placed at the centre and read as S_ref, then the device under test is read as S_DUT, and the ratio times the certified value gives the test flux. But the test lamp's envelope, holder and reflector absorb light inside the sphere and change M, so an auxiliary lamp mounted on the wall is lit with the standard lamp and then with the test lamp in place (both unlit), and the ratio of those readings is the self-absorption correction factor. The standard lamp's current, warm-up time and polarity must follow its certificate or the certified value no longer applies.
units.model: 標準燈 Φ_ref = 1000 lm、S_ref = 2.000 V、待測燈 S_DUT = 1.500 V；輔助燈在標準燈在位時讀 1.040 V、待測燈在位時讀 1.000 V，自吸收修正 α = 1.040/1.000 = 1.040。Φ_DUT = Φ_ref×(S_DUT/S_ref)×α = 1000×0.750×1.040 = 780 lm；若忽略自吸收只得 750 lm，偏低 3.8%。若再乘第 4 單元的光譜失配修正 1.015，最終值為 792 lm。~With a standard lamp Φ_ref = 1000 lm reading S_ref = 2.000 V and a test lamp reading S_DUT = 1.500 V, and the auxiliary lamp reading 1.040 V with the standard lamp in place and 1.000 V with the test lamp in place, the self-absorption correction is α = 1.040/1.000 = 1.040. Φ_DUT = Φ_ref×(S_DUT/S_ref)×α = 1000×0.750×1.040 = 780 lm; ignoring self-absorption gives 750 lm, 3.8% low. Applying the unit-4 spectral mismatch factor of 1.015 as well gives a final 792 lm.
units.verify: 用兩支互相獨立校正的標準燈互量：以 A 為標準量 B，結果應落在 B 的證書值 ±（兩者不確定度合成）內；再把一個黑色吸收體放入球內重做自吸收測試，確認輔助燈法能偵測到 2–5% 的吸收變化。每次量測都記錄標準燈的電流與累積點燈時數。~Cross-check two independently calibrated standard lamps by measuring B against A; the result must lie within B's certified value plus the combined uncertainty of both. Then insert a black absorber and repeat the self-absorption test to confirm that the auxiliary-lamp method detects a 2–5% absorption change. Log the standard lamp's current and cumulative burning hours at every measurement.
units.failure: 標準燈以交流電源點亮且電流偏高 1%，燈絲溫度上升使光通量多出約 3.5%，所有以它校正的量測值全部偏高；證書上的直流電流條件被當成建議而非規定。~Running the standard lamp on AC with the current 1% high raises the filament temperature and adds about 3.5% to its flux, biasing every measurement calibrated against it; the DC current condition on the certificate was treated as advice rather than a requirement.
units.misconception: 待測燈不點亮時放在球裡對量測沒有影響，所以不需要自吸收修正。~An unlit test lamp inside the sphere has no effect on the measurement, so self-absorption correction is unnecessary.

units.anchor: 不確定度預算表~Uncertainty budget table
units.title: 不確定度來源與合成~Uncertainty sources and their combination
units.mechanism: 總光通量的不確定度由標準燈認證值、光譜失配、自吸收、空間響應不均勻（燈的配光與標準燈不同時，球壁各區響應差異會引入誤差）、偵測器線性與漂移、以及重複性等項組成；各項以相對標準不確定度表示，彼此獨立時用均方根合成，再乘涵蓋因子 k = 2 得到擴充不確定度。預算表的價值在於指出哪一項主導：對白光 LED 常是標準燈與光譜失配，對指向性強的燈具則是空間不均勻。~The uncertainty of total luminous flux combines the standard lamp's certified value, spectral mismatch, self-absorption, spatial non-uniformity (when the test source's intensity distribution differs from the standard lamp, response differences across the wall introduce error), detector linearity and drift, and repeatability; each is expressed as a relative standard uncertainty, independent terms are combined root-sum-square, and a coverage factor k = 2 gives the expanded uncertainty. The value of the table is to show which term dominates: for white LEDs usually the standard lamp and spectral mismatch, for highly directional luminaires the spatial non-uniformity.
units.model: 相對標準不確定度（k = 1，教學假設）：標準燈 0.50%、光譜失配 0.40%、自吸收 0.20%、空間不均勻 0.30%、偵測器線性與漂移 0.15%、重複性 0.10%。合成 u_c = √(0.50² + 0.40² + 0.20² + 0.30² + 0.15² + 0.10²) = √0.5725 = 0.76%，擴充不確定度 U(k = 2) = 1.5%。把標準燈改為 0.30% 的更高等級，u_c 只降到 0.65%，因為光譜失配已成為第二大項。~Relative standard uncertainties (k = 1, teaching assumptions): standard lamp 0.50%, spectral mismatch 0.40%, self-absorption 0.20%, spatial non-uniformity 0.30%, detector linearity and drift 0.15%, repeatability 0.10%. Combined u_c = √(0.50² + 0.40² + 0.20² + 0.30² + 0.15² + 0.10²) = √0.5725 = 0.76%, expanded uncertainty U(k = 2) = 1.5%. Upgrading the standard lamp to a 0.30% class lowers u_c only to 0.65%, because spectral mismatch has become the second-largest term.
units.verify: 逐項驗證預算：以掃描小光源得到的空間響應分布，配合待測燈的配光曲線數值積分出空間不均勻項；以 10 次重裝重量得到重複性；以光度計與光譜輻射計兩路徑的差異驗證光譜失配項；最後把合成值與連續三個月的管制圖標準差比較，兩者應同量級。~Verify the budget term by term: integrate the spatial response distribution from the small-source scan against the test lamp's intensity distribution to obtain the non-uniformity term; obtain repeatability from 10 reload-and-remeasure cycles; validate the spectral-mismatch term from the difference between the photometer and spectroradiometer paths; finally compare the combined value with the standard deviation of a three-month control chart, which should be of the same order.
units.failure: 預算表把「標準燈不確定度」與「偵測器校正不確定度」兩項重複計入，又漏掉空間不均勻，報出 0.8% 的擴充不確定度，比對時卻與國家實驗室差 2%，En 值超過 1。~The budget double-counts the standard-lamp and detector-calibration terms while omitting spatial non-uniformity, reports a 0.8% expanded uncertainty, and then differs from the national laboratory by 2% in a comparison, giving an En value above 1.
units.misconception: 重複性很好就表示不確定度很小。~Good repeatability means the uncertainty is small.

units.anchor: 球心燈座、擋板與溫度控制~Centre mount, baffle and temperature control
units.title: 系統整合：燈具安裝、熱平衡與空間均勻性~System integration: mounting, thermal equilibrium and spatial uniformity
units.mechanism: 整合時要決定燈的安裝方式（球心 4π 或開口 2π）、擋板的位置與尺寸（遮住燈到偵測器的直視線但不遮太多壁面）、導線與燈座的顏色與尺寸（白色且最小化），並確保偵測器視野只看到被擋板遮蔽後的壁面。LED 光源的光通量隨接面溫度下降，球內空氣溫度又因燈的功耗上升，所以要等熱平衡並記錄溫度，或以溫控座固定 LED 溫度；大型燈具則須注意球的尺寸應遠大於燈具，否則空間不均勻項失控。~Integration decides how the lamp is mounted (4π at the centre or 2π at a port), where and how large the baffle is (blocking the direct line from lamp to detector without hiding too much wall), the colour and size of leads and holders (white and minimal), and ensures that the detector's field of view sees only baffled wall. LED flux falls with junction temperature while the air inside the sphere warms from the lamp's dissipation, so the system must reach thermal equilibrium with temperature logged, or hold the LED on a temperature-controlled mount; for large luminaires the sphere must be much larger than the luminaire or the spatial non-uniformity term runs out of control.
units.model: 白光 LED 的光通量溫度係數約 −0.3%/K（教學假設）；若球內空氣在 10 分鐘量測中升溫 3 K，光通量漂移 −0.9%，已超過第 6 單元預算中的重複性項 9 倍。以溫控座把接面溫度穩定在 ±0.2 K 內，漂移降到 ±0.06%。鎢絲燈則相反：點燈後需 10–15 分鐘才達熱平衡，前 5 分鐘的讀值可偏差 1% 以上。~A white LED's flux temperature coefficient is about −0.3%/K (teaching assumption); if the air inside the sphere warms by 3 K during a 10 minute measurement, the flux drifts by −0.9%, nine times the repeatability term in the unit-6 budget. Holding the junction temperature within ±0.2 K on a temperature-controlled mount reduces the drift to ±0.06%. Tungsten lamps behave the opposite way: they need 10–15 minutes to reach thermal equilibrium, and readings in the first 5 minutes can be off by more than 1%.
units.verify: 點亮待測 LED 後每 30 秒記錄一次訊號與座溫，畫出穩定曲線，訂出達到 ±0.1% 穩定所需的等待時間；再以小光源掃描法量 4π 配置下的空間響應分布，確認球壁各區的響應差異在 ±2% 內，且擋板陰影區沒有超過 5% 的凹陷。~After switching on the test LED, log signal and mount temperature every 30 s, plot the settling curve and set the waiting time needed for ±0.1% stability; then map the spatial response distribution in the 4π configuration with the small-source scan, confirming that wall-region responses lie within ±2% and that the baffle shadow shows no dip beyond 5%.
units.failure: 為了方便接線把黑色矽膠線與金屬支架留在球內，自吸收修正雖能補償平均吸收，但支架在偵測器附近造成局部陰影，指向性燈具的量測值隨方向變動 3%。~Leaving black silicone leads and a metal bracket inside the sphere for convenient wiring lets self-absorption correction compensate the average absorption, but the bracket casts a local shadow near the detector and directional luminaires read 3% differently with orientation.
units.misconception: LED 一通電就可以量，不像鎢絲燈需要預熱。~An LED can be measured the instant it is powered, unlike a tungsten lamp that needs warm-up.

units.anchor: 國家實驗室比對與 En 值~National-laboratory comparison and En value
units.title: 追溯、比對與量測系統交接~Traceability, comparison and measurement-system handoff
units.mechanism: 量測系統交接的最後一步是證明它與國家計量體系一致：把一支傳遞標準燈送到 NIST、PTB 或 NMIJ 等實驗室校正，再回到本實驗室以替代法量測，用 En 值比較兩者。En = (x_lab − x_ref)/√(U_lab² + U_ref²)，絕對值 ≤ 1 表示在各自宣告的擴充不確定度內一致。交接文件需包含配置圖、標準燈清單與證書、自吸收與光譜失配修正程序、不確定度預算、管制圖與塗層反射率的定期檢查紀錄，因為塗層老化會使替代法以外的任何快速檢查失效。~The last step of handing over the measurement system is to prove consistency with the national measurement system: a transfer standard lamp is calibrated at NIST, PTB, NMIJ or a similar laboratory, measured again at home by substitution, and the two results compared through the En value. En = (x_lab − x_ref)/√(U_lab² + U_ref²), and |En| ≤ 1 means agreement within the stated expanded uncertainties. The handoff file must include the configuration drawing, the list of standard lamps with certificates, the self-absorption and spectral-mismatch procedures, the uncertainty budget, control charts and the periodic coating-reflectance check, because coating aging invalidates any quick check other than substitution.
units.model: 本實驗室量得傳遞燈 x_lab = 1012 lm、U_lab = 15 lm（1.5%，k = 2）；國家實驗室 x_ref = 1000 lm、U_ref = 8 lm。En = 12/√(15² + 8²) = 12/17.0 = 0.71 ≤ 1，比對通過。若本實驗室把不確定度低估為 5 lm，En = 12/√(25 + 64) = 1.27，反而判為不一致，顯示誠實的不確定度評估是比對成敗的關鍵。~The home laboratory measures the transfer lamp as x_lab = 1012 lm with U_lab = 15 lm (1.5%, k = 2); the national laboratory reports x_ref = 1000 lm with U_ref = 8 lm. En = 12/√(15² + 8²) = 12/17.0 = 0.71 ≤ 1, so the comparison passes. Had the home laboratory understated its uncertainty as 5 lm, En = 12/√(25 + 64) = 1.27 and the result would be judged inconsistent, showing that honest uncertainty evaluation decides the outcome.
units.verify: 每年至少一次執行傳遞標準燈的往返比對並計算 En；每季以兩支內部標準燈互量，差異超過 0.5% 就啟動塗層反射率檢查；每次維修或清潔球壁後，重新量測空間響應分布與自吸收因子並更新交接文件。~Run a round-trip comparison with a transfer standard lamp at least yearly and compute En; cross-measure two in-house standard lamps every quarter and trigger a coating-reflectance check if they differ by more than 0.5%; after any repair or cleaning of the sphere wall, remeasure the spatial response distribution and self-absorption factor and update the handoff file.
units.failure: 實驗室用三年前校正的標準燈持續量測，燈絲蒸發使光通量每 100 小時下降約 0.5%，累積後所有產品的標示光通量偏高 2%，直到客戶在另一個實驗室複測才發現。~A laboratory keeps using a standard lamp calibrated three years earlier; filament evaporation lowers its flux by about 0.5% per 100 hours, all products end up labelled 2% high, and the discrepancy surfaces only when a customer remeasures elsewhere.
units.misconception: 積分球校正一次之後就永久有效，因為球本身沒有活動部件。~An integrating sphere stays calibrated forever because it has no moving parts.

example: LED 總光通量量測練習：直徑 200 mm 的燒結 PTFE 球，ρ = 0.98、有效開口比 f = 0.03，M = 0.98/(1 − 0.98×0.97) = 19.8；球內表面積 A_s = 0.1257 m²。待測白光 LED 輻射通量約 1 W 時壁面輻照度 E = 1×19.8/0.1257 = 157.9 W/m²，輻射亮度 L = 50.3 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹，1 mm² 矽偵測器收到 0.158 mW、光電流約 52 µA。替代法：標準燈 1000 lm 讀 2.000 V，LED 讀 1.500 V，輔助燈在標準燈與 LED 在位時分別讀 1.040 V 與 1.000 V，自吸收修正 α = 1.040；光譜失配修正 F* = 1.015。Φ_DUT = 1000×(1.500/2.000)×1.040×1.015 = 792 lm。不確定度：u_c = 0.76%（k = 1），U = 1.5%（k = 2），即 792 ± 12 lm。若球壁因污染使 ρ 降到 0.97 而標準燈未在同一天重量，M 由 19.8 降到 16.4，所有結果會偏低 17%——這就是每次量測都要重做替代法的原因。所有數值皆為教學假設。~LED total-luminous-flux exercise: a 200 mm sintered-PTFE sphere with ρ = 0.98 and effective port fraction f = 0.03 has M = 0.98/(1 − 0.98×0.97) = 19.8 and interior area A_s = 0.1257 m². For a white LED emitting about 1 W of radiant flux the wall irradiance is E = 1×19.8/0.1257 = 157.9 W/m², the radiance L = 50.3 W·m⁻²·sr⁻¹, and a 1 mm² silicon detector receives 0.158 mW, about 52 µA of photocurrent. Substitution: the 1000 lm standard lamp reads 2.000 V, the LED reads 1.500 V, the auxiliary lamp reads 1.040 V and 1.000 V with the standard lamp and the LED in place, so the self-absorption correction is α = 1.040; the spectral mismatch factor is F* = 1.015. Φ_DUT = 1000×(1.500/2.000)×1.040×1.015 = 792 lm. Uncertainty: u_c = 0.76% (k = 1), U = 1.5% (k = 2), i.e. 792 ± 12 lm. If contamination lowered ρ to 0.97 and the standard lamp were not remeasured the same day, M would fall from 19.8 to 16.4 and every result would read 17% low, which is why substitution is repeated at every measurement. All values are teaching assumptions.
history: 1892 年 Sumpner 提出以漫反射球腔量測總光通量的原理，1900 年 Ulbricht 建造實用的「烏布利希球」並用於燈具光通量量測，積分球因此在歐洲常以他命名。二十世紀中葉國際照明委員會（CIE）將替代法與自吸收修正寫入光通量量測技術報告，1979 年成立的 Labsphere 在 1980 年代推出燒結 PTFE 漫反射材料，使可見到近紅外的壁面反射率達到 0.99；近年 LED 照明普及，CIE S 025 等標準與 NIST 的總光譜輻射通量刻度把積分球量測推向光譜化與更低的不確定度。本課只重建公開原理與量測程序。~In 1892 Sumpner proposed measuring total luminous flux with a diffusely reflecting spherical cavity, and in 1900 Ulbricht built the practical Ulbricht sphere for lamp flux measurement, which is why the device often carries his name in Europe. In the mid-twentieth century the International Commission on Illumination (CIE) codified substitution and self-absorption correction in its luminous-flux technical reports; Labsphere, founded in 1979, introduced sintered-PTFE diffuse material in the 1980s, raising wall reflectance to 0.99 from the visible to the near infrared. With the spread of LED lighting, standards such as CIE S 025 and NIST's total spectral radiant flux scale have pushed sphere measurement toward spectral methods and lower uncertainty; this course reconstructs only public principles and procedures.
